records.name: welcome
records.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: an original welcome photograph for a beginner violin app tutorial, landscape 3:2 composition, intended for mobile center cropping.
Primary request: A bright, inviting, real home violin practice table, ready to begin.
Scene/backdrop: A quiet beige home interior in natural daylight, a warm wood practice table, a small sage-green houseplant. Simple, believable lived-in materials with restrained clutter.
Subject: One ordinary unbranded acoustic violin safely upright in a stable padded violin stand on the table, its matching bow safely resting beside it. A single smartphone on a small support beside the violin, screen facing the viewer and completely blank light cream. The violin, bow and phone form one central group and remain recognizable when cropped for a phone.
Style/medium: High-quality realistic lifestyle product teaching photography, authentic wood grain and violin varnish, accurate everyday objects, no illustration or CGI appearance.
Composition/framing: Wide horizontal 3:2 image. Main instrument and phone inside the central 65 percent of the frame, generous calm background, eye-level three-quarter view, the whole violin safely supported. Keep the bow visible, distinct and naturally sized.
Lighting/mood: Soft natural window daylight, warm and encouraging, subtle realistic shadows, cream, sage and warm wood palette.
Constraints: Exactly one violin with four strings and four tuning pegs, one bow, one blank-screen phone. No people, hands, faces or likenesses. No printed music or branded packaging. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, album imagery, famous artwork, recognizable copyrighted characters or third-party reference images. No UI or icons on the phone. Opaque photographic background.

records.name: tuner
records.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original tuning-step photograph for a beginner violin app tutorial, landscape 3:2, suitable for mobile center cropping.
Primary request: A calm close view of a real ordinary four-string violin head and tuning pegs, with a blank-screen smartphone nearby, suggesting tuning before playing.
Scene/backdrop: A bright cream-colored home practice space with warm wood and subtle sage-green background tones, soft window daylight.
Subject: One unbranded traditional acoustic violin scroll, pegbox and upper neck in close-up. The instrument is safely supported off-frame, no hand touching it. The pegbox has exactly four traditional ebony tuning pegs, two on each side, with four strings correctly passing over the nut into the pegbox. Make the four pegs and string paths clearly distinguishable and mechanically believable. Nearby, a single phone sits upright on a simple stand with a completely blank light cream screen, no graphics or text.
Style/medium: Realistic premium teaching product photography with natural wood varnish, ebony and fine string detail, authentic optical depth of field, no illustration or CGI look.
Composition/framing: Wide horizontal 3:2. Violin pegbox and phone grouped in the center 65 percent, viewed at a clear three-quarter angle that reveals all four tuning pegs. The complete scroll, pegbox and nut remain within frame; softly blurred clean room background. Calm negative space at the edges.
Lighting/mood: Gentle natural daylight, quiet precise preparation, cream/sage/warm wood palette, realistic soft shadows.
Constraints: Exactly four violin pegs and four strings. No hands, people, faces or likenesses. No tuner device logos, numbers, pitch names, tuning diagrams or meters. No UI or icons on the phone. No text, letters, watermark, album images, famous artwork, recognizable copyrighted characters or third-party reference images. Opaque photographic background.
